answer_1.quote: In visual storytelling (VIST), a generation model tells a short story to describe the given five images.
answer_1.outputs: short stories describing sequences of images

answer_2.quote: Traditional n-gram-based or reference-based autometrics such as BLEU, ROUGE, and METEOR are common for VIST evaluation.

answer_4.quote: Hsu et al. (2020) asks human annotators to rank five stories from different models based on overall quality. Hu et al. (2020b) and Wang et al. (2020b) conduct pairwise human evaluations to rank stories according to different story aspects, where the latter is judged to be closer to human-level.
answer_4.guideline: workers were to rank the story by overall quality, from the best story to the worst story
